# EntanglementAwareRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network routing policy that selects paths for quantum data transmission based on the availability and fidelity of entangled links. Optimizes end-to-end quantum communication reliability in multi-core systems where entanglement generation is probabilistic and decoherence-prone.
